nodes.title: Global Prompt Preview
widgets_values:
Create a highly consistent, photorealistic image of a 25-year-old Caucasian woman with naturally blonde hair, styled in a short, textured crop that frames her face with soft layers and subtle tousling. She has striking, bright blue eyes with a slightly almond-shaped structure, giving her a sharp yet approachable gaze. Her facial structure is defined with a high cheekbone structure, a slightly angular jawline, and a narrow nose with a gentle upward turn at the tip. Her lips are medium-sized, full, and slightly pinkish in tone, with a natural, well-groomed appearance.

She is of athletic build, standing at an average height (approximately 5'6"), with a toned but not overly muscular physique. Her shoulders are slightly broad, and her arms and legs are lean but defined, showing signs of regular physical activity. Her posture is upright and confident, with a natural, relaxed stance. She has a slim waist and a proportional, hourglass figure with a defined but not exaggerated curve.

Her skin is fair with a healthy, slightly sun-kissed tone, and has a smooth texture with minimal blemishes. Her facial features are well-proportioned and balanced, with a small, upturned nose and a soft, natural blush on her cheeks. Her eyebrows are naturally arched, slightly thick, and well-groomed, adding to her alert and expressive appearance.

The overall style should be photorealistic, with attention to detail in lighting, texture, and expression. She should appear approachable, confident, and youthful, with a modern, urban aesthetic. Use high-resolution rendering and natural lighting to enhance realism.
